program.name: Federal Child Tax Credit (CTC)
program.description_short: A federal tax credit for families with qualifying children
program.description:
The Child Tax Credit lowers the amount you owe on your federal taxes. You can claim one credit for each qualifying child in your household.

You claim the credit when you file your federal tax return. Some families may get part of the credit as a refund.

Children claimed for this credit must be U.S. citizens, nationals, or residents. Before your tax return is due, they need Social Security numbers that are valid for work. You or your spouse must have one too. If you file together, the other spouse may use an SSN or ITIN by the same deadline.

To claim this credit, click "File for free" to file your federal tax return at no cost.

1099 for all household members in tax unit

Schedule 8812 (Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents)
Form 8862, if the IRS previously reduced or denied your Child Tax Credit for a reason other than a math or clerical error

navigators.name: VITA Free Tax Preparation (IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance)
navigators.description: Free tax preparation help for people who earn low to moderate income. Trained volunteers can help you file your federal return and claim the tax credits you qualify for, including the CTC.

navigators.name: AARP Foundation Tax-Aide
navigators.description: AARP Foundation Tax-Aide provides free federal tax preparation help at sites across Missouri. Volunteers can help you claim the CTC on your federal return. No AARP membership required. Use the site locator to find an appointment near you.
